2608.11994.title: Claim-Level Reliability Assessment for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
2608.11994.paper_summary: We propose claim-level falsification as a principle for test-time scaling and instantiate it through Claim-Level Reliability Assessment (CLR), a training-free framework that reallocates test-time compute from additional solution sampling to targeted verification. Since whole-trace evaluation often obscures decisive errors due to signal dilution from routine tokens, CLR condenses each reasoning trace into a compact set of decision-critical claims, thereby isolating its logical anchors. Furthermore, recognizing the inherent difficulty of generating entirely correct solutions under fixed model capabilities, CLR shifts the focus to semantic falsification. This approach exploits a fundamental asymmetry between solution construction and claim refutation. Constructing a valid solution requires a flawless reasoning path, whereas refuting an incorrect claim requires identifying only a single decisive flaw. This targeted search for negative evidence systematically compresses the survival space of high-confidence incorrect traces, effectively suppressing erroneous consensus via nonlinear reliability scoring. Across four LLMs and four reasoning benchmarks under matched budgets, CLR generally improves upon pass@1 and self-consistency. On GPT-OSS-20B/CMIMC25, for instance, CLR exceeds pass@1 by 27.15 percentage-points and raises self-consistency accuracy from 77.50\% to 82.19\% with 37.0\% fewer tokens.
2608.11994.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了聲明級虛假化作為測試時間擴展的原則，並通過聲明級可靠性評估（CLR）來具體化，這是一個無需訓練的框架，將測試時間的計算從額外的解決方案抽樣重新分配到針對性的驗證上。由於整個追蹤評估常常因例行標記的信號稀釋而掩蓋決定性錯誤，CLR 將每個推理追蹤壓縮為一組緊湊的決策關鍵聲明，從而孤立其邏輯錨點。此外，考慮到在固定模型能力下生成完全正確解決方案的固有困難，CLR 將重點轉向語義虛假化。這種方法利用了解決方案構建和聲明駁斥之間的根本不對稱性。構建有效的解決方案需要無瑕疵的推理路徑，而駁斥不正確的聲明則只需識別單個決定性缺陷。這種針對負證據的搜索系統性地壓縮了高信心不正確追蹤的生存空間，通過非線性可靠性評分有效抑制錯誤共識。在四個 LLM 和四個推理基準下，CLR 通常在 pass@1 和自我一致性上有所改善。例如，在 GPT-OSS-20B/CMIMC25 上，CLR 的 pass@1 提高了 27.15 個百分點，並將自我一致性準確率從 77.50\% 提升至 82.19\%，同時減少了 37.0\% 的標記數。
